c2_bad.why: Still carries the three forbidden concepts for this task - virtualised rows, inline edit with Enter/Escape, selection checkbox column with select-all - for a 30-row read-only invoice list. The shadcn adaptation self-limits virtualisation to >200 rows but the record text and its concept tags push the heavier artefact. It also remains the only carrier of data.pagination_strategy, which it never actually describes (comp-pagination is again absent).

Not harmful, but the project already has route-level loading.tsx/error.tsx and an in-body empty state; the record restates what the code does and does not touch scanability. Occupies a bundle slot while process.reuse_first (critical, existing-UI fix) is again dropped by the cap.

c2_direction_unjustified.why: 'sharp' contradicts the codebase: --radius is 0.5rem and every panel is rounded-lg; 01-inspect itself reports radius=small, not none.

why: c2 adds data-exceptions-first - the exact record whose absence c1's RESULTS flagged as a knowledge gap and whose content the implementer had to invent (exceptions grouped first, count in the header, no colour alone) - and the direction drops the four c1 over-reaches (cta-toolbar-commands, imagery-data-graphics, metadata-rich, grid_behavior=virtualized) by leaving those slots null; the cost is losing web-responsive-breakpoints, which in c1 caught the 390px clipping defect.
